page_title: ROM 2-2 SAL | AS Roma v Salernitana 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
90+6' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
90+5' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is easily saved by Guillermo Ochoa.
90+2' Jose Mourinho decides to make a substitution. Houssem Aouar will be replaced by Riccardo Pagano (AS Roma).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mamadou Coulibaly (Salernitana) will replace Erik Botheim.
87' The players claim that Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
85' The corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is intercepted by Guillermo Ochoa.
83' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Federico Fazio (Salernitana), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
82' 2 - 2 Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the top left corner. The score is 2:2.
82' AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
81' The cross into the penalty area from Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
78' Here is a change. Grigoris Kastanos is going off and Paulo Sousa gives the last tactical orders to Junior Sambia (Salernitana).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giulio Maggiore trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
78' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
75' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guillermo Ochoa, who smothers the ball.
73' A cooling break is underway.
72' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
72' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick.
70' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
70' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
68' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guillermo Ochoa intercepts the ball.
67' The foul by Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ermano Feliciani.
66' Substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi walks off the pitch and Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) comes on as a substitute.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) replaces Chris Smalling.
65' Renato Sanches (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Edoardo Bove.
65' Jose Mourinho has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) replacing Leonardo Spinazzola.
65' A substitution has been made. Rasmus Kristensen goes off and Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) comes on.
64' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
62' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) commits a rough foul. Ermano Feliciani stops the game and makes a call.
60' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
60' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
57' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
54' Close! Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.

54' AS Roma are awarded a free kick in a very promising position and they have several players who are capable of scoring from this kind of range. Who will be the one to take it? Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) brings his opponent down. Ermano Feliciani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.

49' 1 - 2 Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) meets a perfect cross from Domagoj Bradaric on the edge of the penalty area and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike straight into the left side of the goal. It's 1:2.
49' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
49' Salernitana take a short corner kick.
48' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Now Salernitana have a corner.
48' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AS Roma.
45+3' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
42' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Guillermo Ochoa.
41' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) sees a yellow card from Ermano Feliciani after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
39' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

36' 1 - 1 Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) controls the ball with a great first touch just outside the penalty area after receiving a pass and smashes the ball into the roof of the net to give the goalkeeper no chance!
35' The game is interrupted. One of the players from AS Roma is cautioned for aggressive play.
33' A rebound falls to Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar.
33' There's an opportunity for Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

31' What a poor attempt! Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
29' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) loses his marker in the box from the resulting corner, times his jump well but flashes his close-range header well wide of the right post.
29' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) will take a corner kick.
28' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. AS Roma get a corner.
26' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
25' The free kick from long range, taken by Salernitana, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
23' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
22' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
22' Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul after Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
21' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
20' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
20' AS Roma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
17' 1 - 0 Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom right corner. What a brilliant finish!
16' Half-chance! Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Guillermo Ochoa reacts well to snuff out the attack.
15' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
11' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
10' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for AS Roma due to an offside in the build-up play.
9' The AS Roma players halt their celebrations as referee Ermano Feliciani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
8' What an excellent finish! Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) latched on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and rifled an unstoppable low drive into the middle of the net and past the helpless goalkeeper.
6' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
5' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) sends a long ball in, but Guillermo Ochoa comfortably gathers the ball.
4' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
2' Referee Ermano Feliciani sees the trip by Diego Llorente (AS Roma) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani is the one to supervise the game today.
